mapper.sql: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.description, i.type, i.status, i.category_id, c.name AS category_name, i.location_id, CONCAT(l.building, COALESCE(' ' || l.floor, '')) AS location_name, l.building, i.event_time, i.image_url, i.user_id AS publisher_id, u.name AS publisher_name, u.contact AS publisher_contact, i.created_at FROM items i LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = i.category_id LEFT JOIN locations l ON l.id = i.location_id JOIN users u ON u.id = i.user_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO items (user_id, title, description, type, status, category_id, location_id, event_time, image_url) VALUES (#{publisherId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{type}, 'pending', #{categoryId}, #{locationId}, #{eventTime}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE items SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, location_id = #{locationId}, event_time = #{eventTime}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE items SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE items SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM claims WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND claimant_id = #{userId} AND status = 'approved' )
